name: 10028 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10028 (New York) has 324 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10028 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10028 (New York) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
